name: LinkedIn Ads
one_liner: Advertising API for programmatically managing LinkedIn ad accounts, campaigns, creatives and reporting.
auth_notes: 3-legged member OAuth with per-product scopes; member needs an ad account role. Daily app and member rate limits exist but numbers are not published; visible per endpoint in the Developer Portal Analytics tab.
access_notes: Create an app, add the Advertising API product, apply for Development tier. LinkedIn reviews applications and may select partners at its discretion; Standard tier is a further upgrade. No fee stated. Private APIs (Matched Audiences etc.) need additional approval.
sandbox_or_test_env: partial: Development tier can create 1 test ad account via API, but all calls hit production data

buildability.rationale: Development tier is applied for through the self-serve Developer Portal form (established business and use case required), no sales contact, up to 5 editable ad accounts. Approval is discretionary; Standard tier needed for scale.

needs_human_reason: Approval is discretionary; confirm Standard tier criteria and approval outcome with LinkedIn Developer Support.

identity.quote: LinkedIn has two tiers of access to our Advertising API: Development and Standard.

auth.quote: CAMPAIGN_MANAGER | View campaign data and reports; Create/Edit campaigns and ads

access.quote: LinkedIn reserves the right to review applications and select partners at its discretion
Do you have an established business?
Create an app, add Advertising API, and complete the access form under My Apps > select your app > Products.

sandbox.quote: Access to create 1 test Ad Account through the API.

api_surface.quote: Standard rate limits are not published in documentation.

buildability.quote: Open to qualified developers, so you can build end-to-end workflows before obtaining full permissions.

disputes.why: Development tier is a self-serve Developer Portal application, no sales or partnership contact; rubric maps app review to caveats. Discretionary approval remains a risk.
Access comes via an application on the app's Products tab, not a partner program.
Daily app and member limits with 429 are documented, though numbers are not published.
Tiers page says Development tier can create 1 test ad account; calls still hit production.
